title: Philly Flattens Sonny, Kai Survives His Own Bench, and Burrow Throws JMoney a Party
dek: Team Pillbert turned the week's coin flip into a 42-point rout and took over as Luffy's title favorite, Dawgs beat the league leaders by less than a point with 32.5 on the bench, and Counting or not Counting GV pulled off the upset of the week.
body: Luffy called the No. 2 vs. No. 3 showdown a coin flip, and it wasn't one. Team Pillbert flattened The Horse is Hea 115.5 to 73.5, the blowout of the week, and Sonny's afternoon ended the moment Lamar Jackson posted a zero on a 22.17 projection. Philly won by 42 with Chuba Hubbard and his 21.4 points sitting on the bench, the same Chuba Hubbard Sonny shipped to him three weeks ago. Alan is now 6-2, his title odds jumped from 20% to 31%, and that's the best number in the league. Beat Habibsters next week and Luffy has Team Pillbert at 100% to make the playoffs.

The game of the week went to Dawgs, who beat No Banner only HULK 129.48 to 128.56, and Kai did it with one hand tied behind his back. Tee Higgins scored 32.5 points on Mekhi's bench while Omar Cooper Jr., picked up this week for Omarion Hampton, started and scored zero. That's a 32.5-point lineup mistake in a game decided by 0.92, and Dawgs won anyway. Ja'Marr Chase (25.6) and Brock Bowers (24.7) did the heavy lifting, and James Cook III added 17.1 in his first start since coming over from Sonny. Mekhi's title odds went from 5% to 13%, the biggest jump on the board.

For Brucie, it was a strange way to lose. D'Andre Swift ran for 26.9 on a 13.12 projection and Josh Allen added 26.56, but Zay Flowers posted a zero on a 16.69 projection, and that's the whole margin plus change. No Banner only HULK is still 6-2, still first, and still leads the league with 1055.9 points, more than 120 ahead of anyone else. But the win streak is over, the title odds fell from 29% to 20%, and Ramon now shares the top record with Philly.

The upset of the week belongs to JMoney. Counting or not Counting GV went into the week with a 30% chance against The fumblers and dropped 138.28, the highest score of the week, in a 32-point win. Joe Burrow threw for 39.48 points on a 22.88 projection, Bhayshul Tuten added 28.9 on a 13.42 projection, and Kirk Cousins scored 28.18 on Jordan's bench, so even the backup showed up. At 2-6 with 1% playoff odds, Jordan is mostly playing spoiler now, but nobody wants to see this lineup in November.

On the other side, Randy's slide has reached five straight losses. The fumblers are 3-5, their playoff odds are down to 5%, and the title odds fell from 7% to 1%. Next week is close to now-or-never: a win puts Randy at 30% to make the playoffs, a loss drops him to 4%.

Habibsters handled Ghostu-Spider SZN 120.96 to 101.62, as Luffy expected, for a third straight win, and Habib is back to 4-4 and holding the fourth playoff spot. The waiver steal of the week did a lot of the work: Drake Maye, picked up within the last three weeks, put up 22.46, which made up for Drake London's 1.3 on a 14.82 projection. Zoey falls to 3-5, and her 762 points are the second-lowest total in the league. She swapped Jaylen Waddle for KC Concepcion this week, and her playoff odds sit at 7%.

The trade market didn't slow down. Mekhi sent Tee Higgins and Jameson Williams to The fumblers for Jonathan Taylor and Amon-Ra St. Brown, so Higgins goes from Kai's most expensive bench spot to Randy's lineup, and Williams lasted exactly one week as a Dawg. Those two teams play each other next week, which should make for an awkward group chat. Elsewhere, Sonny picked up Hampton right after Mekhi dropped him and added Marvin Harrison Jr. and Hunter Henry, Alan brought in Geno Smith, and Brenton Strange went from Philly's drop to Jordan's tight end spot.

Next week, the headliner is Habibsters vs. Team Pillbert: Jahmyr Gibbs is the swing player for Philly and Puka Nacua for Habib, whose playoff odds are 68% with a win and 44% with a loss. Sonny needs Jaxon Smith-Njigba to stop the bleeding against JMoney, who will ride Burrow again. Z² brings the Jordan Love-to-Tucker Kraft stack and Bijan Robinson against Ramon and Josh Allen. Then there's The fumblers vs. Dawgs: Derrick Henry vs. Ja'Marr Chase, Higgins against his old team, and a loser who's probably cooked.

social.author: Gamma Ray Gang
social.text: Zay Flowers. 16.69 projected. Zero. Swift and Allen carrying this whole team on their backs and Zay is out here doing nothing. Brucie deserved better today.

social.author: Buckaroo Football League
social.text: Week 8 final: No Banner only HULK and Team Pillbert share the top record at 6-2. Dawgs won the closest game of the season so far, 129.48 to 128.56. Team Pillbert can reach 100% playoff odds with a win in Week 9.

trade_watch.take: This one keeps getting worse for Sonny. Hubbard has 48 points since the deal, and Philly could afford to bench his 21.4 while beating Sonny by 42, while Pickens and Ollie Gordon combined for 12.7 on The Horse is Hea's bench this week.

Rashee Rice finally scored for Ramon, 14.8 points, his first since the deal, and they came from the bench. Hubbard has 73.4 since leaving Brucie's side, all of it for other teams, which makes this the weirdest trade in the league so far.

Week one goes to Kai: Cook started and scored 17.1 in a win, while Watson and Jeanty gave Sonny 22.1 in a blowout loss. Jeanty is now on his third team since Week 5, and Jameson Williams has already moved on to Randy.
Still lopsided, and still going Philly's way. Javonte Williams has 81.7 points since the trade, all in Team Pillbert's lineup, while Stefon Diggs has given The fumblers 17.3 in theirs.

Justin Jefferson has 34 points since the deal, all in Philly's lineup, including 11.8 this week. Mekhi got 40.6 out of Jeanty before moving him and has Davante Adams, who sat out this week, so the deal looks more even than it first did, but Alan still holds the bigger name.

bios.1: A 73.5-point dud, led by Lamar's zero, dropped Sonny to 5-3 and his title odds to 20%. Playoff odds are still at 91%, but the new pickups need to start producing against JMoney next week.
bios.2: Five straight losses have Randy at 3-5 with 5% playoff odds. He just added Tee Higgins and Jameson Williams from Dawgs, and next week against Mekhi is about as close to must-win as it gets.
bios.3: JMoney put up the week's best score, 138.28, behind Joe Burrow's 39.48, and knocked off Randy as a big underdog. At 2-6 the playoffs are a long shot, but the spoiler role suits this team just fine.
bios.4: Philly beat Sonny by 42, moved to 6-2, and is now Luffy's title favorite at 31%. A win over Habibsters next week locks up the playoffs, and the trades keep paying off.
bios.5: Kai beat the league leader despite 32.5 points on his bench, then traded for Jonathan Taylor and Amon-Ra St. Brown. At 3-5 with title odds up to 13%, next week against Randy has a lot riding on it: 46% playoff odds with a win, 15% with a loss.
bios.6: Three straight wins have Habib back to 4-4 and holding the last playoff spot, with Drake Maye looking like a smart waiver pickup. Next week against Team Pillbert, a win takes Kaushal to 68% playoff odds and a loss drops him to a coin flip.
bios.7: Still 6-2, still first, and still the league's highest-scoring team by more than 120 points. A 0.92-point loss to Dawgs ended the win streak and dropped Ramon's title odds to 20%, and he now shares the top record with Philly.
bios.8: Zoe's rookie season has stalled at 3-5, with the second-lowest point total in the league after a loss to Habib. The Love-to-Kraft stack is still her best shot, and next week she needs it against Ramon.
